import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

def _pack(z, feas, has_cust):
    inf = torch.full_like(z, float("inf"))
    lo = torch.where(feas, z, inf).min(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    lo = torch.nan_to_num(lo, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    dep = torch.where(has_cust, lo - 1.0, torch.zeros_like(lo))
    return torch.cat([z.masked_fill(~feas, float("-inf")), dep], dim=-1)

              load, feasibility_mask):

    d_ci = (unselected_locs - current_loc.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
